name: @jixo/mcp-pnpm

tools.name: install
tools.description: Installs all dependencies for a project.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

frozenLockfile.description: Disallow changes to the lockfile. Fails if the lockfile is out of sync.

filter.description: In a monorepo, limit the command to a subset of projects. See pnpm filtering docs for syntax.

tools.name: add
tools.description: Adds one or more packages to project dependencies.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

packages.description: The list of packages to add (e.g., ['zod', 'typescript@latest']).

dev.description: Install as a 'dev' dependency. CHOICE GUIDANCE: Use for build tools, test frameworks, and linters (e.g., 'typescript', 'jest', 'eslint').

optional.description: Install as an 'optional' dependency. CHOICE GUIDANCE: Use for non-critical dependencies.

filter.description: In a monorepo, limit the command to a subset of projects.

workspaceRoot.description: Add the dependency to the root workspace package.json.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

packages.description: The list of packages to remove.

filter.description: In a monorepo, limit the command to a subset of projects.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Executes a script defined in the project's `package.json`.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

script.description: The name of the script to run.

scriptArgs.description: Arguments to pass directly to the executed script.

filter.description: In a monorepo, limit the command to a subset of projects.

tools.name: list
tools.description: Lists installed packages and their dependencies.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

depth.description: The maximum depth of the dependency tree to display.

json.description: Show information in JSON format. CHOICE GUIDANCE: Set to true for programmatic use.

production.description: Display only the dependency graph for packages in 'dependencies'.

dev.description: Display only the dependency graph for packages in 'devDependencies'.

filter.description: In a monorepo, limit the command to a subset of projects.

tools.name: outdated
tools.description: Checks for outdated packages. A great precursor to using the 'update' tool.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

packages.description: A list of specific packages to check.

json.description: Show information in JSON format. CHOICE GUIDANCE: Set to true for programmatic use.

recursive.description: Check for outdated dependencies in every package in a monorepo.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Updates packages to their latest version based on the specified range in package.json.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

packages.description: A list of specific packages to update. If omitted, all dependencies are updated.

latest.description: Ignore the version range specified in 'package.json' and update to the 'latest' tag.

recursive.description: Update dependencies in every package in a monorepo.

interactive.description: Show outdated dependencies and select which ones to update. AI NOTE: This is NOT recommended for automated environments as it requires human interaction. Use 'outdated' first.

tools.name: dlx
tools.description: Fetches and runs a package from the registry without installing it as a dependency.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

commandAndArgs.description: The package/command to execute, followed by its arguments.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Creates a new project from a starter kit.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

template.description: The starter kit or template to use (e.g., 'vite', 'react-app').

templateArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the create command.

tools.name: licenses
tools.description: Checks and lists the licenses of installed packages.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

json.description: Show information in JSON format. CHOICE GUIDANCE: Set to true for programmatic use.

long.description: Show more details, like package paths.

filter.description: In a monorepo, limit the command to a subset of projects.

cwd.description: The working directory to run the command in. Defaults to the current directory.

extraArgs.description: An array of extra, less-common command-line arguments to pass to pnpm. Example: ['--reporter=json'].

packages.description: One or more package specifications to view (e.g., 'zod', 'typescript@latest').

json.description: Show information in JSON format. CHOICE GUIDANCE: Set to true for programmatic use.

stderr: MCP pnpm server running on stdio. Ready for commands.
